_readme: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and edit. Never commit real keys: put them in env vars and reference them with api_key_env.

providers._comment: PRIMARY: Google Gemini from TrueForge's catalog (no name/base_url: the provider is named after its type). Any other catalog provider (openai, anthropic, ...) or a type 'custom' OpenAI-compatible endpoint works the same way. Set GEMINI_API_KEY in your shell. Free tier is ~15 requests/minute; the extension waits out 429s automatically.

FALLBACK: a local model behind Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (no key needed; a placeholder is used). Start Ollama with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384 so prompts are not truncated. Use a model that supports tool calling.
providers.name: fallback-llm
